description: Creates a new container in a GTM account. usage_context declares the platform, e.g. ["web"]; other values include androidSdk5, iosSdk5, server. Returns the created Container with its server-assigned containerId and publicId. Requires the tagmanager.edit.containers scope.

name.description: Display name of the new container.

usage_context.description: Usage contexts, e.g. ["web"]. Other documented values: androidSdk5, iosSdk5, server.

name: create_container
title: Create a container
